outcomes.description: Write equivalent matrices, linear systems, and vector equations.
outcomes.template:
Consider the following system of equations:

{{system}}

Write an augmented matrix corresponding to this system.

{{matrix}}

exercises.html:
Consider the following system of equations:

\[\begin{matrix} 3 x & & & + & z & = & -2\\ 4 x & + & y & - & 4 z & = & -7\\ 4 x & + & y & - & 3 z & = & -6\\ 2 x & + & y & - & 2 z & = & -3\\ \end{matrix}\]

Write an augmented matrix corresponding to this system.

\[\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}3 & 0 & 1 & -2 \\ 4 & 1 & -4 & -7 \\ 4 & 1 & -3 & -6 \\ 2 & 1 & -2 & -3\end{array}\right]\]
exercises.pretext:
